summary.headline: Crescent Visibility Distances
summary.text: Discussion of crescent visibility after sunset using the lunar equatorial distance and equal distance between the two ephemerides, with thresholds for thin, moderate, and prominent crescents. The accompanying ephemeris table records these distances at the beginning of each month, along with brightness, darkness, height, and moderation.
